page.layout: One printed page. Top: title block (PRIMA PARS METAPHYSICÆ. DE ENTE COMMUNI), centred, with a decorative band above. Then the centred introductory paragraph, a rule, the chapter heading (CAPUT PRIMUM), a centred italic summary, a rule, the article heading (ARTICULUS PRIMUS), and below it one justified text block with a woodcut initial E at the left. No margin notes. Page number at top right. Signature B at bottom right.

main_text.l: Hæc pars dividitur in quinque capita. Primo, agi-tur

Entis realis: Secundò, de Ente rationis.

page.notes: The top edge has faint, illegible print (possibly a running head or show-through); left out. The "B" at bottom right is the signature. A small mark "1" stands at the left edge beside the initial; it is not clearly text and was not transcribed. The word ENTE in the title is partly covered by a black blot, so the T is doubtful. "vllo" in the body: the printed form "uullo" is uncertain, so the word is marked [?]. The woodcut E is the initial of ENs. Printed hyphens at line ends (agi-tur, Veri-tate, subsisten-tiæ) are kept as the paragraph's own spelling. The bottom-right corner has a faint digitiser credit, which was left out.
